knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The suction valves are closed and the pump is confirmed off before the lid is opened, so that water and air do not move through the open strainer.
A damaged cover is an entrapment risk. Supervision and referral are the correct response, and replacement needs the owner's instruction.
Hazardous voltage makes isolation the first step before any motor or pump work, as the product manual warns.

practicalCriteria: Valve positions are recorded before and after the change, and the pump is observed off before the lid is opened
Strainer basket and seal are inspected, cleared and replaced correctly
Suction outlet condition is observed, and any problem is referred with the time and the supervising adult named
Pump is started only after the lid is closed and the valves are set
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of valve positions and gauge readings
Referral note for any suction outlet or motor concern
stopWorkCriteria: Strainer lid opened while the pump operates or with suction valves open
Pump or motor worked on with power connected
Suction outlet used or repaired with a cracked or missing cover
Pump started with an unseated lid or damaged seal
